Gorham, New Hampshire · stay

Hotels in Gorham for cyclists

Places to stay in Gorham when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: Mt. Washington Auto Road Bicycle Hillclimb.

Hotels in Gorham for cyclists, listed

  1. The Glen House

    $$$ · 979 NH Route 16, Gorham, NH 03581

    Modern hotel at the base of the Auto Road, across the street from Great Glen Trails; the closest bed to the start line.

  2. Top Notch Inn

    $$ · 265 Main Street, Gorham, NH 03581

    Motel in the village on Main Street, listed by the Androscoggin Valley Chamber; a short drive down Route 16 to the Auto Road.

  3. Town & Country Inn and Resort

    $$ · 20 State Route 2, Shelburne, NH 03581

    Larger inn just east of the village with pool, hot tub and restaurant, and direct trail access.
